props.name: asChild
props.description: Use the provided child element as the default rendered element, combining their props and behavior.

props.name: autoFill
props.description: Whether to automatically duplicate content to fill the container.

props.name: defaultPaused
props.description: Whether the marquee is paused by default.

props.name: delay
props.description: The delay before the animation starts (in seconds).

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the marquee. Useful for composition.

props.name: loopCount
props.description: The number of times to loop the animation (0 = infinite).

props.name: onComplete
props.description:
Function called when the marquee completes all loops and stops.
Only fires for finite loops (loopCount > 0).

props.name: onLoopComplete
props.description: Function called when the marquee completes one loop iteration.

props.name: onPauseChange
props.description: Function called when the pause status changes.

props.name: paused
props.description: Whether the marquee is paused.

props.name: pauseOnInteraction
props.description: Whether to pause the marquee on user interaction (hover, focus).

props.name: reverse
props.description: Whether to reverse the animation direction.

props.name: side
props.description: The side/direction the marquee scrolls towards.

props.name: spacing
props.description: The spacing between marquee items.

props.name: speed
props.description: The speed of the marquee animation in pixels per second.

props.name: translations
props.description: The localized messages to use.
